subject: 马厩
prompt: Use case: historical-scene. Generate exactly ONE isolated game building sprite for tianshu default, Ming dynasty northern Chinese prefectural city architectural kit, original anonymous composite, not a reconstruction of a named monument. Realistic ancient Chinese architecture, same natural material realism and detail density as the attached Song stable reference; reference is style ONLY, change architecture to northern Ming gray brick and gray clay tile, modest timber, restrained hard-gable yingshan roof with straight compact eaves. Orthographic 2:1 dimetric projection, yaw 45 degrees, pitch 30 degrees, NO perspective convergence. East ground axis projects down-right at slope +0.5; north ground axis up-right at slope -0.5; vertical posts stay vertical. Thin almost-flat footprint pad with clearly visible left, front, right corners, not a pedestal. Footprint proportions refer to ground axes, NOT canvas proportions. Main light from SCREEN UPPER LEFT; short soft contact shadow toward lower right. Entire object and base uncut, generous transparent margins. TRUE TRANSPARENT RGBA background, no opaque background or painted checkerboard. No people, animals, writing, pseudo-glyphs, signs, numbers, modern objects, palace ornament on common buildings, Qing imperial decoration, fantasy, neighboring buildings, sky, water, scenery, thick diorama plinth, broad shadows, tilt shift, toy plastic, cropping. Asset bld_kit_ming_north_stable. One compact deep 8 by 6 metre northern Ming stable, only THREE broad open stalls under one low hard-gable gray tiled roof, with gray brick gable ends, dark timber supports, wooden troughs and straw visible inside. NO HORSES, no people, no cart. Simple square wooden lattice vent at side. Avoid decorative upturned eaves, palace ridges, white plaster tourist architecture. Ground width:depth =8:6, flat thin rectangular gray brick apron with left/front/right corners visible. It must be deep, not a long narrow shed. Slopes +0.5/-0.5.

references.role: 仅材质、细节密度和写实程度，屋顶年代与视角须服从本prompt
